'''Shears''' are a [[Tools|tool]] used to collect [[wool]] from [[sheep]]. They must be purchased from [[Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|1000}}.

Each use of the Shears to shear a sheep consumes 4 points of [[energy]], and increases the player's [[Farming]] experience by 5 points.

Once the player has reached [[Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Level 10]], an [[Auto-Grabber]] can be purchased from Marnie's Ranch for {{Price|25000}}, which will automatically shear all sheep from the [[barn]] in which it is placed.
